article.title: Venezuela demands Bank of England return its gold reserves
article.author: teleSUR Desk
article.content: Acting President Delcy Rodriguez demanded Wednesday that the Bank of England return Venezuela’s gold, calling the metal a Central Bank reserve that belongs to the Venezuelan people and declaring that no excuse remains. The post Venezuela demands Bank of England return its gold reserves appeared first on MR Online .
